This game is the Milsim to end all Milsims. I have never played a better realistic military game, and believe me, nothing even comes close. Obviously the game is more than a decade old and that shows in the outdated graphics, but it is nothing the amazing steam workshop community cannot fix with a few mods. The game gives you unlimited freedom, from building your own missions in the editor to playing one of the many campaigns that allows different ways to approach. The showcases all demonstrate single player missions in their specific verticals, and provide an excellent way to get used to the aspects of the game. And I haven't even started on the multiplayer yet... All I can say is that there is no community like it, from deep roleplay servers that simulate real military to giant 150 player king of the hill matches, you will always find a new mode to play. Shout out to a few mods: AFR Factions reimagined is an awesome mod that gives new factions and weapons, and I totally love playing around with that in the editor. Antistasi and Dynamic Recon Ops allow endless single-player and co-op fun, and the 3den enhanced improves quality of life in the editor by a mile. OK, so you've heard the pros, but every game has it's faults and in an honest review I need to point those out. The mechanics are outdated and difficult to learn, leading to a steep learning curve that takes at least 2 hours to master. The graphics are outdated, and the quickplay function is completely broken. However, you don't need a graphical beast to play this game. I play it on my PC as well as my weaker laptop, and it runs smoothly on both. I'm pretty sure you'll be fine with an NVIDIA RTX 1080 or higher, and 16GB of ram is sufficient if you run it on HD 1080p.

TD;LR: If you are looking for an awesome military game to play by yourself or with a few friends, this will be the best $30 you ever spent. If you like fast paced, high graphical quality fps games like Call of Duty, you might want to reconsider.
